name: Technocore Safe Agent — DID × XAIP
summary: Local-first Ed25519 DID tooling, Japanese safety guidance, offline-verifiable Technocore receipts, and an XAIP v1 identity-binding bridge.
problems: A portable execution receipt needs a cryptographic binding between its public key and claimed agent identity.
Japanese-language participants need a local-first path that does not expose private keys or passphrases.

capabilities.claim: Creates and encrypts an Ed25519 private key locally without third-party runtime dependencies.
Normalizes, signs, locally verifies, and submits Technocore messages over HTTPS POST.
Creates XAIP formatVersion 1 receipts from newly measured signed Technocore actions.
Checks that the receipt SPKI public key matches the Ed25519 key embedded in a standard did:key:z6Mk identity.

limitations: A DID signature proves key control, not the truth or quality of content.
Technocore server responses are not server-signed.
Receipts are not automatically submitted to the XAIP public aggregator.
No execution measurement is created retroactively.
